dict.string: Margin records your voice so it can transcribe your meetings on this Mac. Audio never leaves your computer.
Margin records the other people on your calls (Zoom, Meet, Teams) by capturing system audio. It is transcribed on this Mac and never uploaded.
Margin saves each meeting as a Markdown file in the folder you chose.
Margin saves each meeting as a Markdown file in the folder you chose.
Margin can name meetings and list attendees from the calendar event happening while you record.
